# Audio Codec<AvailableFrom v="3.3.41" />

Set the format of the audio that is embedded in the video. Not all codec and audio codec combinations are supported and certain combinations require a certain file extension and container format. See the table in the docs to see possible combinations.

## CLI flag

```text
--audio-codec <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#audiocodec)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#audiocodec)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#audiocodec)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#audiocodec)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#audiocodec)
- [`canRenderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/can-render-media-on-web#audiocodec)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#audiocodec)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAudioCodec('pcm-16');
```
